text:
alyssa: Heads-up: OSS refapp hackday scheduled for Wed 09:00 PST. Goal: launch a trimmed refapp, a short blog, and a 20–30s benchmark narrative we can use in social + webinar promo. :rocket:

devin: Nice. DevRel can staff a livestream/demo. Can we narrow the benchmark ask? what metrics do we want called out?

alyssa: Thinking three bullets for the post: 1) p50 latency for 512 tokens, 2) tokens/sec on a single dedicated box, 3) cost per 1k tokens vs baseline. Keep bench run reproducible.

elaine: I'll produce a reproducible script. Proposed command to include in the repo:```
# run a quick perf sweep
rwi bench --model redwood/3b --seq 512 --batch 4 --duration 120 --label hackday
```
This outputs p50/p95, throughput, and GPU mem. We should pin CUDA + container hashes in the README.

sam: For the blog post we need a 2-paragraph narrative + 3 screenshots: console perf dashboard, trace flamegraph, and refapp UI. Who's owning images/alt text?

alyssa: Marketing owns the post draft + images. @devin can you capture the demo flow and a short script for the livestream? @elaine add console export screenshots to the PR.

devin: On it. I'll record 2x 3-min clips: 1) cold start + latency, 2) scaled throughput with batching. Will drop clips in /shared/marketing/assets.

elaine: Quick note on the benchmark: enable KV prefix cache for the refapp runs so numbers reflect cache-aware serving. I'll include flags: `--kv-cache on --cache-size 2GB`. Also will include raw CSV for analytics.

sam: Inbound lead routing: when we launch, route high-intent demo requests to the devrel queue for 2 weeks, then hand to sales. Suggest bifurcated form: "Try refapp" (devrel) vs "Enterprise trial" (sales).

alyssa: Agreed. @jenny-bot can you add a short note to the launch checklist and ping the eng-oncall channel 1hr before go-live?

jenny-bot: scheduled message set: `Post: "Refapp hackday launch in 1 hour" -> channel: eng-oncall` at 2028-10-17T08:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

devin: Draft for social: "Built on Redwood Inference — 3-minute refapp to show production latency and cost tradeoffs. Live demo Wed 9AM PST. Link + benchmarks in thread." I'll post once Alyssa approves. :eyes:

alyssa: Copyapproved for social with tiny edits. I'll push draft to /marketing/drafts and tag for review. Can everyone drop a quick +1 on the draft by EOD Monday?

elaine: +1

sam: +1

devin: +1

alyssa: Thanks all — last asks: (1) devrel to prep 1 pager for webinar follow-up leads, (2) eng to export perf CSVs into the repo, (3) marketing to finalize blog by Tuesday noon. We'll use the hackday to collect the screenshots and raw bench artifacts. :sparkles:
